description: USDA-APHIS halted inspections and all Mexican avocado imports after a threat against a US plant-safety inspector in Michoacan; imports resumed on Feb 18, 2022.
Impatiens necrotic spot virus plus hot weather cut Salinas/Central Valley lettuce yields by up to half; iceberg FOB prices peaked in October-November 2022.
CDC announced a multistate Salmonella Africana/Braenderup outbreak linked to cucumbers in June 2024 (551 cases in 34 states by Aug 22, 2024).
TikTok creator Logan Moffitt's cucumber salad videos went viral from July 2024; widely reported cucumber sell-outs (e.g. Iceland) in August 2024.

event_name: McDonald's E. coli outbreak traced to slivered onions
description: CDC announced the McDonald's Quarter Pounder E. coli O157:H7 outbreak on Oct 22, 2024; Taylor Farms recalled yellow onions on Oct 25; outbreak declared over Dec 3, 2024.
SunFed Produce recalled American/slicer cucumbers grown by Agrotato (Sonora, Mexico) on Nov 27, 2024 after a Salmonella Typhimurium outbreak (68 cases in 19 states by Nov 26).

event_name: USDA pauses avocado inspections in Michoacan
description: Two USDA employees were attacked in Michoacan on June 14, 2024; the US suspended avocado and mango inspections there (announced June 18) and began a gradual resumption around June 21.
An E. coli O157 outbreak (84 cases in MI, OH, IN, PA by late August 2022) was linked to romaine on Wendy's sandwiches; Wendy's pulled the lettuce on Aug 19, 2022.
